verdict.rationale: Intel's own vendor stack explicitly documents support for this silicon's CPU/GPU/NPU via OpenVINO (NPU device docs referencing Core Ultra/Meteor Lake+ NPUs), oneAPI/oneDNN with PyTorch optimizations for Core Ultra Series 2 and Arc GPUs, and explicit 48 TOPS NPU on-device AI claims for Lunar Lake (258V's generation). Missing for 10: no independent llama.cpp/MLX/ONNX Runtime community benchmarks or hands-on confirmation specific to the 258V, only first-party docs.
